title: Export Personal Data
intro: WordPress lets an administrator generate a .zip of all personal data stored for an email address and send the download link to that person, as required by privacy regulations such as the GDPR.
backdrop: Backdrop core has no personal-data export. The data an account holds can be read on its profile and in its content and comments, but packaging it is left to site builders.
